description: Explicit, capability-aware, bundler-neutral TypeScript application, build, and runtime contracts.
rules: Treat the nearest package status note and the documentation index as authoritative about whether an API is executable, a source preview, or planned.
Use public imports from @kunlun-js package roots; never recommend importing from src or dist paths.
Do not present roadmap items as implemented behavior.
Kunlun Next.js is Next.js-style but does not claim Next.js application, plugin, rendering, or deployment compatibility.
Report build-engine capabilities and documented fallbacks instead of assuming parity across Nasti, Vite, Webpack, and Rspack.
